newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Central Bank gold reserves 397 T.
newsitem.headline: Russia Central Bank gold reserves 397 T.

text.p: Russia's Central Bank gold reserves were 397 tonnes on April 20, the bank's First Deputy Chairman Sergei Aleksashenko said on Friday.
He also said that the Russian government held another 24.8 tonnes of gold in separate reserves.
Aleksashenko said that based on a gold price of $300 per ounce, the Central Bank's gold reserves were worth around $3.8 billion, and those of the government around $250 million.
The bank's currency reserves were $12.8 billion, he told a news conference.

Last month Aleksahenko said the Central Bank was holding about 400 tonnes of gold as at the end of January. He also said in March that the bank intended to boost its reserves by 90 tonnes during 1997.
